name: Roland Lescure
role: Minister of the Economy, Finance and Industrial, Energy and Digital Sovereignty
bio: Roland Lescure is a French-Canadian economist and politician who has served as Minister of the Economy, Finance and Industrial, Energy and Digital Sovereignty in the governments of Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu since October 2025, a post he retained in the 26 February 2026 reshuffle (Lecornu II). A member of Renaissance, he is the member of the National Assembly for the first constituency for French residents overseas (Canada and the United States), first elected in 2017. Before entering politics he was a money manager in France and Chief Investment Officer of the Caisse de depot et placement du Quebec (CDPQ), and he previously served as Minister Delegate for Industry from 2022 to 2024.
